project_type: Python FastAPI AI backend for SNBP admission prediction (part of a multi-service Docker Compose app)
test_framework: pytest with TestClient from FastAPI, tests in ai_backend/tests/
verification_instructions: Run pytest with verbose output, all tests must pass including new ones
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot pip install new packages from PyPI. Must work with pre-installed packages or add them to requirements.txt for Docker build context only. Use AST-level validation and existing test infrastructure.
contribution_requirements: Keep all 47 existing tests passing. Add new tests for new endpoints. Don't break existing endpoint signatures.

key_patterns.app_structure: FastAPI app in ai_backend/app/main.py, models in app/models/, schemas in app/schemas/, services in app/services/
key_patterns.predictor_pattern: Global singleton `predictor` in app/models/predictor.py with predict() method returning (prob, lower, upper) tuple
key_patterns.schema_pattern: Pydantic BaseModel classes in app/schemas/prediction.py with Field validators
key_patterns.test_pattern: pytest with TestClient, module-scoped fixtures for predictor setup, class-based test organization
key_patterns.startup: on_event('startup') loads SIDATA and ML model
key_patterns.feature_cols: FEATURE_COLS = [avg_score, ranking_percentile, accred_score, competition_ratio, applicant_trend, daya_tampung]

directory_structure: ai_backend/app/ (FastAPI app), ai_backend/models/ (joblib model), ai_backend/tests/ (pytest), ai_backend/training/ (training scripts), database/ (SQL seeds), website/ (PHP frontend), docker-compose.yml (orchestration)
